subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: What Is Procurement
description: Learn What Is Procurement in one minute.

hook.text: A hospital runs out of surgical gloves during a pandemic. The failure wasn't medical—it was procurement.

buildup.text: Procurement is the process of finding, buying, and receiving goods and services a company needs to operate.

discovery.text: It includes identifying needs, selecting suppliers, negotiating terms, placing orders, and managing delivery.

twist.text: Procurement isn't just buying. It's strategic. The right supplier at the right price changes everything.

climax.text: Companies spend 50–70% of revenue on purchased goods. Procurement directly controls profitability.

punchline.text: What you buy and from whom defines your bottom line.

quiz.question: What share of revenue do companies typically spend on procurement?
